xmldoc.short_description: Like intervalTest but the bounds come from input ports (lo, u, up).

description.p: Like intervalTest but the bounds come from input ports (lo, u, up).

Signal-driven variant of intervalTest: instead of parameters, the lower bound, the value and the upper bound are read from input ports 1, 2 and 3 respectively, so the acceptance window can move at run time. Output is 1 when lo <= u <= up. IntervalClosedLeft/IntervalClosedRight control end inclusivity. Element-wise over the value width; scalar bounds broadcast.
